e8_proposal.fix_is_the_primarys_to_choose: Lane E does not choose it. The bare rule 'a presentation finding whose quote is present may not stand' is NOT safe and is explicitly not proposed - a legitimate presentation finding quotes present text it wants rewritten, and dismissing those would weaken a real check. The discriminator is that this finding alleges a gap while stating none: absent empty, fact_ids empty, and its own quote already inside the section it names, which one targeted_repair attempt then left byte-identical. Whether that belongs in scope_defect (label-independent, item 37's principle), in rounds.py (a revision identical to its input did not repair anything), or in prompts/independent_review.yaml (an omission claim must populate absent) is a design call for whoever owns all three.
e8_proposal.reversal_path: If the owner rules that a presentation finding is a prose judgment call no deterministic check may dismiss (section 26), then this composition's class is permanent and the repository needs a different composition, not a reviewer change - and item 39 should be re-read in that light too, since it made the same call for factuality.
